summary: Allied Gold Corp filed a Form 6-K furnishing its November 4, 2026 press release reporting third-quarter 2026 financial and operational results. The company produced 91,195 ounces of gold at all-in sustaining costs of $2,378 per ounce sold, with net earnings of $29.1 million ($0.22 basic, $0.20 diluted) and adjusted EBITDA of $139.8 million. It also disclosed the start of production at the Kurmuk Mine and cash of $379.1 million at September 30, 2026. This is a routine earnings and operations update, not a special situation; no transaction terms apply.
